# About Codalina
Welcome to Codalina, a fully digital marketplace built with a vision to make technology more accessible and reliable. We specialize in offering carefully selected digital products, including source codes, UI components, and high-quality electronics (earphones, earbuds, speakers, neckbands, and more)—all through a seamless online experience. 

At Codalina, we believe in simplicity, transparency, and continuous improvement. Every product we offer is 100% original and chosen with care to deliver value and quality to our customers. As a growing platform, we are committed to building trust through honest service, a smooth shopping experience, and ongoing innovation. Our journey has just begun, and we are excited to grow alongside our community. Thank you for being part of the Codalina story.

# Core Categories
1. **Quality Electronics** — 100% original gadgets including earphones, earbuds, speakers, and neckbands.
2. **Digital Products** — Carefully selected source codes, UI components, and software assets.

# Content Index

The main marketplace to explore and buy premium digital and physical tech products.

## Products
Individual product pages with detailed descriptions, images, and pricing.
URL pattern: https://codalina.com/product/{id}
